content: Řefḍiḥet i iggin ayt n Binyamin
Deg wussan nni, umi war din tuɣi ajeǧid di Israil, tuɣa din ijj n Ulawi izeddeɣ d abarrani deg ijj n wemcan ɣar iɣezdisen n idurar n Ifrayim. Netta yiwi ict n temɣart d tayya zi Bayt-Laḥm di Yahuda.
Maca tayya nnes tedweř tessefḍeḥ ixef nnes umi ɣares tt tuɣa uca tesmeḥ dayes, teɛqeb ɣar taddart n babas di Bayt-Laḥm di Yahuda. Dinni teqqim aṭṭas n wussan, arebɛa n iyuren.

Xenni ikkar weryaz, iḍfar i-tt ḥima ad kis issiweř s wuř nnes maḥend ad tt-i-dd-issareggʷeḥ. Tuɣa amsexxar nnes ameẓyan akides d ict n tyuya n yeɣyař. Uca nettat tiwyi i-t ɣar taddart n babas. Umi t iẓra babas n tḥenjirt ifarḥ řami kides i ɣa immeřqa.
Aḍeggʷař nnes, babas n tḥenjirt, igga xas aṭṭas aɣiř maḥend akides iqqim třata n wussan. Nitni ccin, swin u ssensen dinni.

Imsar deg wass wiss arebɛa, aqa nitni faqen zic ɣar tuffut u netta ikkar ixs ad yuyur. Xenni inna babas n tḥenjirt i wesři nnes: “Semḥeḍ ixef nnec s yijj n uřeqquz n weɣrum, xenni ad taf tzemmarem ad tuyurem.”
Nitni qqimen, ccin, swin s tnayen idsen nsen. Xenni inna babas n tḥenjirt i weryaz: “Ttzawgeɣ, qqim da, ad tessensed uca ad ifarḥ wuř nnec.”
Aryaz ikkar ḥima ad yuyur, maca aḍeggʷař nnes ikellef xas, igga xas aɣiř ḥima ad dinni issens ɛawed.
Deg wass wiss xemsa ikkar zic ɣar tuffut ḥima ad yuyur. Inna babas n tḥenjirt: “Arni semḥeḍ uř nnec!” U nitni qqimen ttrajan ař ɣa iɛdu wass uca ccin tnayen idsen munen.

Xenni ikkar weryaz ḥima ad yuyur, netta ak-d tayya nnes d umsexxar nnes. Aḍeggʷař nnes, babas n tḥenjirt, inna: “Xzar, ass ggur ad iɛdu tiweḍ-dd tmeddit, ttzawgeɣ sensem da. Xzar, sfarḥ uř nnec u kkarem tiwecca zic maḥend ad tᵉṭṭfem abrid ɣar tqiḍunt nnec.”
Maca aryaz war ixs ca ɛad ad issens. Ikkar uca yuyur, yiweḍ ař qibač Yabus, tenni d Urcalim, u tuɣa ict n tyuya n yeɣyař bardɛen d tayya nnes aqa-tt akides.
Umi ten tuɣa nitni ɣar Yabus, tuɣa ass ad iɛdu. Xenni inna umsexxar i bab nnes: “Uyur, ad da nḍar di tendint-a n Iyabusiyyen, ad dayes nessens.”
Maca sidi nnes yarra-dd xas: “Neccin war nettmeyyiř ɣar ict n tendint taɣribt, tenni war iǧin n ayt n Israil, maca ad narni ad nuyur ɣar Jibɛa.”
Netta inna ɛawed i umsexxar nnes: “As-dd, ejj aneɣ ad narzu ad naweḍ ɣar ijj zeg imucan nni, ad nessens di Jibɛa niɣ di Rama.”
Nitni arnin uyuren u teɣři xasen tfuct umi ten-tuɣa nitni ɣar Jibɛa nni iǧan n Binyamin.
Uca ssfarɣen zeg webrid, ḥima ad adfen ɣar din maḥend ad ssensen di Jibɛa. Umi ɣar din yudef, iqqim deg wazzay n tendint, minzi war ten issidef ḥed ɣar taddart maḥend ad ssensen.

Uca xzar, ɣar tmeddit iɛqeb-dd yijj n uwessar zi řxedmet nnes zeg iyyar. Tuɣa aryaz nni ɛawed zeg idurar n Ifrayim, maca izdeɣ am abarrani di Jibɛa, maca imezdaɣ n temmurt nni tuɣa aten d ayt n Binyamin.
Issgeɛɛed netta tamuɣři nnes, ixzar aryaz nni tuɣa dd-ikkin d abrid deg wazzay n tendint. Awessar inna: “Mani ɣa tuyured u manis i dd-tusid?”

Inna as netta: “Neccin neffeɣ-dd zi Bayt-Laḥm ař ṭṭarf qaɛ ḍeffar x idurar n Ifrayim, ssenni i dd-usiɣ. Necc tuɣa uyureɣ ɣar Bayt-Laḥm di Yahuda, uca řexxu ggureɣ ɣar Taddart n SIDI uca war da uřa d ijj wenni ixsen ad ayi issidef ɣar taddart nnes,
waxxa neccin ɣarneɣ řum d řeɛřef i yeɣyař nneɣ uřa d aɣrum d binu i necc, i tayya nnec u i uḥudri nni iǧan ɣar imsexxaren nnec. War d aneɣ ixeṣṣ walu.”
Xenni inna uwessar: “Ad kik yiři řehna! Maca min i d ac iqqimen, aqa-t ɣari, mɣir ittxeṣṣa war tᵉttnusid deg wazzay.”
Netta issidef i-t ɣar taddart nnes, iwca řeɛřef i iɣyař u nitni ssirden iḍaren nsen, ccin swin.

Di řweqt d ict řami ifarḥ wuř nsen, xzar, deɣya nnḍen-dd yeryazen n tendint i taddart - iryazen nni d ayt i war isekkwin - uca ssqarqben di tewwart. Nitni ssiwřen ak-d weryaz awessar, bab n taddart, nnan: “Suffeɣ-dd aryaz, wenni dd-yudfen ɣar taddart nnec, ɣar barra, neccin nexs akides newḍa.”
Aryaz, bab n taddart, iffeɣ-dd ɣarsen, inna asen: “Lla, a aytma, war tteggem ca tuɛɛefna, awarni řami dd-yudef weryaz-a řexxu ɣar taddart inu. Ɣarwem ad teggem řefḍiḥet am tanita.
Xzar, yeǧi d taɛzarect d tayya nnes ad ɣarwem tent ssuffɣeɣ. Sehwam tent u ggem akidsent min texsem, maca deg weryaz-a war tteggem řefḍiḥet am tanita.”
Maca iryazen war xsen ad ɣarsen sřan. Xenni iṭṭef aryaz tayya nnes, issuffeɣ i-tt-dd ɣarsen ɣar barra. Nitni uřyen xas, jeyyḥen tt ǧiřet tekmeř ař tuffut u nitni jjin tt ad tuyur ařami isbeḥ řḥař.
Umi d tarreẓ tuffut, tusa-dd temɣart-a uca tewḍa ɣar tewwart n taddart n weryaz mani tuɣa iǧa sidis nnes, teqqim din ařami i dd-teffeɣ tfawt.
Umi dd-ikkar sidis ɣar tuffut, yarzem tiwwura n taddart uca iffeɣ ɣar barra, ḥima ad iṭṭef abrid nnes, xzar, din i tewḍa temɣart, tayya nnes, ɣar tewwart n taddart s ifassen nnes x tnebdat.
Netta inna as: “Kkar bedd, neccin nexs ad nuyur!” Maca uřa d ijj war xas dd-yarri. Xenni issars i-tt x weɣyuř uca iṭṭef abrid ɣar wemcan n tzeddiɣt nnes.
Umi yiweḍ netta ɣar taddart, iksi ijj n řmus, iṭṭef tayya nnes, iqess i-tt x tenɛac n tseqqar uca issekk i-tent ɣar marra jjwayeh n Israil.
Uca imsar, aqa qaɛ wenni iẓrin aya, inna: “Man aya ɛemmarṣ ɛad war imsar uřa war t neẓri zeg wass i di ffɣen ayt n Israil zi Miṣra ař ass-a. Xemmem dayes, mcawarem ak-d wayawya uca inim řeḥkam!”
